# Generated by build_economy.py. Do not edit.
jxp_a_clear_market_interfaces_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_1
		clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_2
		clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_3
		clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_4
		clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_public_credit_ready
	}
}

jxp_a_sync_market_interfaces_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		jxp_a_clear_market_interfaces_effect = yes
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1 } set_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_1 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2 } set_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_2 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_3 } set_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_3 }
		else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_4 } set_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_4 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_public_credit_instituted
				jxp_a_market_stage_at_least_2_trigger = yes
			}
			set_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_public_credit_ready
		}
	}
}

jxp_a_reconcile_economic_identity_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		# Pre-v1.10 mission rewards used permanent foundation modifiers.  Consume
		# them once into the canonical country flags before removing the legacy
		# modifiers, so later reconciles remain idempotent.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_blade
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_edict
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_league
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_modifier = jxp_24_foundation_blade }
				set_country_flag = jxp_24_unification_by_blade
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_blade
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_modifier = jxp_24_foundation_edict }
				set_country_flag = jxp_24_unification_by_edict
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_edict
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_modifier = jxp_24_foundation_league }
				set_country_flag = jxp_24_unification_by_league
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_league
			}
		}
		remove_country_modifier = jxp_24_foundation_blade
		remove_country_modifier = jxp_24_foundation_edict
		remove_country_modifier = jxp_24_foundation_league
	}
}

jxp_a_set_market_stage_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2 has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_3 has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_4 } } }
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_3
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_4
			clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_1
			clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_2
			clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_3
			clr_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_4
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1
			set_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_1
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1_rewarded } }
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1_rewarded
				add_country_modifier = {
					name = jxp_a_market_stage_1_transition
					duration = 3650
				}
			}
		}
	}
	jxp_a_sync_market_interfaces_effect = yes
}

jxp_a_clear_illegal_market_stages = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_4 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_3
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_3 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1
		}
		jxp_a_sync_market_interfaces_effect = yes
	}
}

jxp_a_reconcile_market_stage = {
	hidden_effect = {
		jxp_a_reconcile_economic_identity_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { jxp_a_has_any_market_stage_trigger = yes } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_4 } jxp_a_restore_market_stage_4_effect = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_3 } jxp_a_restore_market_stage_3_effect = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_2 } jxp_a_restore_market_stage_2_effect = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_1 } jxp_a_restore_market_stage_1_effect = yes }
		}
		jxp_a_clear_illegal_market_stages = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { jxp_a_has_any_market_stage_trigger = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_capstone_complete
					has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_company_charter_active
				}
				jxp_a_restore_market_stage_4_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_factory_network_complete } jxp_a_restore_market_stage_3_effect = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_public_credit_instituted } jxp_a_restore_market_stage_2_effect = yes }
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					jxp_a_is_domestic_economy_country_trigger = yes
					has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_estates_ready
					num_of_cities = 5
					total_development = 60
					has_estate = estate_burghers
					estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_burghers loyalty = 40 }
					jxp_a_market_stage_1_two_of_three_support_trigger = yes
				}
				jxp_a_set_market_stage_1 = yes
			}
		}
		jxp_a_sync_market_interfaces_effect = yes
	}
}

	jxp_a_reconcile_market_stage = yes
}

jxp_a_reconcile_companies_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_chartered } }
			jxp_a_clear_company_mining_operating_state_effect = yes
			remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_mining_charter
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_chartered
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_state_expanding
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_state_stable
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_state_distressed
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_state_audited
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_state_reformed
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_state_stable
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_nationalized
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_mining_nationalized_modifier }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_company_mining_nationalized_modifier duration = -1 }
		}
		else = {
			remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_mining_nationalized_modifier
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_bankrupt_cleanup
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_mining_bankruptcy_modifier }
			}
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_bankrupt_cleanup
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_chartered } }
			jxp_a_clear_company_shipping_operating_state_effect = yes
			remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_shipping_charter
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_chartered
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_state_expanding
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_state_stable
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_state_distressed
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_state_audited
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_state_reformed
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_state_stable
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_nationalized
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_shipping_nationalized_modifier }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_company_shipping_nationalized_modifier duration = -1 }
		}
		else = {
			remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_shipping_nationalized_modifier
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_bankrupt_cleanup
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_shipping_bankruptcy_modifier }
			}
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_bankrupt_cleanup
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_chartered } }
			jxp_a_clear_company_rice_credit_operating_state_effect = yes
			remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_charter
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_chartered
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_state_expanding
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_state_stable
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_state_distressed
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_state_audited
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_state_reformed
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_state_stable
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_nationalized
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_nationalized_modifier }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_nationalized_modifier duration = -1 }
		}
		else = {

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_bankrupt_cleanup
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_bankruptcy_modifier }
			}
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_bankrupt_cleanup
		}

			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_textile_chartered } }
			jxp_a_clear_company_textile_operating_state_effect = yes
			remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_textile_charter
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {

				NOT = {
					OR = {

						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_textile_state_stable
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_textile_state_distressed
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_textile_state_audited
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_textile_state_reformed
					}

			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_textile_bankrupt_cleanup
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_textile_bankruptcy_modifier }
			}
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_company_textile_bankrupt_cleanup
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_armaments_chartered } }
			jxp_a_clear_company_armaments_operating_state_effect = yes
			remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_armaments_charter
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {

		}

	hidden_effect = {
		add_adm_power = -75
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_household_particularism_outcome_central
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_household_particularism_outcome_estate

		set_country_flag = jxp_a_household_particularism_outcome_central
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_household_particularism_resolved

			limit = { has_estate = estate_nobles }
			add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_nobles loyalty = -5 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = jxp_a_household_particularism_central_settlement
			duration = 3650
		}
		jxp_a_clear_household_particularism_runtime_effect = yes
	}

		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_failure
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_central
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_resolved
		if = {
			limit = { has_estate = jxp_estate_village_communes }
			add_estate_loyalty = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes loyalty = -5 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_central_settlement
			duration = 3650
		}
		jxp_a_clear_tokusei_communal_rising_runtime_effect = yes
	}
}

jxp_a_resolve_tokusei_communal_rising_estate_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		add_dip_power = -75
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_central
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_estate
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_failure
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_estate
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_resolved
		if = {
			limit = { has_estate = jxp_estate_village_communes }
			add_estate_loyalty = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes loyalty = 10 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_estate_settlement
			duration = 3650
		}
		jxp_a_clear_tokusei_communal_rising_runtime_effect = yes
	}
}

jxp_a_resolve_tokusei_communal_rising_failure_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		add_stability = -1
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_central
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_estate
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_failure
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_failure
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_resolved
		if = {
			limit = { has_estate = jxp_estate_village_communes }
			add_estate_loyalty = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes loyalty = -10 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_failed_settlement
			duration = 3650
		}
		jxp_a_clear_tokusei_communal_rising_runtime_effect = yes
	}
}

jxp_a_force_end_tokusei_communal_rising_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_active }
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_resolved
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_disaster = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising }
			end_disaster = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising
		}
		jxp_a_clear_tokusei_communal_rising_runtime_effect = yes
	}
}

jxp_a_clear_tokusei_communal_rising_persistent_state_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_disaster = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising }
			end_disaster = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising
		}
		jxp_a_clear_tokusei_communal_rising_runtime_effect = yes
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_resolved
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_central
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_estate
		clr_country_flag = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_outcome_failure
		remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_central_settlement
		remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_estate_settlement
		remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_tokusei_communal_rising_failed_settlement
	}
}

	hidden_effect = {
		jxp_a_clear_household_particularism_persistent_state_effect = yes
		jxp_a_clear_religious_diet_collapse_persistent_state_effect = yes
		jxp_a_clear_merchant_oligarchy_persistent_state_effect = yes
		jxp_a_clear_tokusei_communal_rising_persistent_state_effect = yes
		jxp_a_company_full_cleanup_effect = yes
		jxp_a_clear_market_runtime_effect = yes
	}
}
